cohort: The study included 200 participants with singleton pregnancies, equally split between those experiencing preterm labor (gestational age 24-36+6 weeks) and a control group with term births (gestational age 37 weeks or beyond).
finding: The study found no significant differences in Systemic Immune Inflammation Index (SII) or other inflammatory markers (NLR, PLR, MLR) between the preterm and term birth groups.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were significantly higher in the preterm group (79%) compared to the control group (43%).
birth_weight: Preterm group had lower birth weights compared to the control group.
gest_age: Preterm group: 24 to 36+6 weeks; Control group: 37 weeks or beyond.
